proposed.explanation: The investor wants a full‑year 2026 earnings‑per‑share (EPS) and P/E ratio for ABUK to decide whether to buy. The only directly verified figure is the nine‑months‑ended‑September‑2026 basic EPS of 8.74 EGP (rows [ABUK‑ABUK_9M2026_results‑p2‑31] and [‑p2‑32]). All other reported figures – revenues and net profit for both nine‑month periods – are marked AMBIGUOUS and may not be used in calculations (they are listed as unused_figures below). No full‑year EPS, guidance, or quarter‑by‑quarter data are provided. Because the nine‑month EPS cannot be simply annualised without unverified assumptions, and the ambiguous profit/revenue figures cannot be employed, there is insufficient reliable evidence to compute a full‑year 2026 EPS or a meaningful P/E ratio. Consequently a responsible buy/sell recommendation cannot be made. The investor should keep cash until more complete data are available.

claims.statement: Verified nine‑months‑ended‑September‑2026 basic EPS = 8.74 EGP per share.

limitations: All revenue and net‑profit figures are AMBIGUOUS and may not be used in any calculation.
Only nine‑month EPS is verified; no full‑year or quarterly data are given.
Annualising the nine‑month EPS would rely on unstated assumptions about the remaining quarter.
Share price of 76.21 EGP is current as of the 2026‑11‑18 cutoff, but without a reliable EPS the P/E cannot be determined.
